title: ST Plumbing & Heating | Boiler & Emergency Plumbers
meta_description: ST Plumbing & Heating provides boiler repairs, servicing, installations and emergency plumbing across Pontefract, Wakefield, Castleford and nearby areas.
h2: Need a Plumber or Boiler Repair Today?
h3: Excellent Company. 1st time customer and very impressed from the beginning to the end. Professional, very knowledgeable and efficient engineer. Cost effective. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend them.

Had a boiler and unvented cylinder service done. Engineer arrived in the time agreed and was really very pleasant. Work was carried out quickly and he communicated well what had been done. Price was also very reasonable too. Happily use their services again.
I trust st for my rental properties and own residence. High quality of work, reliable and easy to deal with. Highly recommended!

ST Plumbing serviced my gas combi boiler for me and fitted an expansion vessel to it to account extra radiators I had fitted in a new extension. Booking was quick and easy, they arrived when they said they would and were done in good time, very tidy job. They were very professional but friendly, offered good advice and explained it to me as a layperson. I will definitely use them again.

Our boiler stopped working over the weekend and Dan was able to come out on the Monday to diagnose the problem and fit a new gas valve on the Wednesday afternoon. Really happy with the speed of the service and fortunately only without heat for a few days. Would strongly recommend ST Plumbing.

Exceptional start to finish. The team relocated our gas supply internally from source to the boiler. Communication was quick, the work was completed to a high standard. All round fantastic service, would definitely recommend.
